title: Mysterious six-feet tall, pale predator near US-Mexico border found stealing chicken. A UFO investigator says it might be from another dimension
description: Recently, a bizarre creature has surfaced in Mexico's Valley of Juárez, allegedly linked to mysterious poultry deaths. UFO researcher Jaime Maussan showcased images of this large, pale beast seen pilfering chickens and adeptly scaling walls. Despite numerous resident sightings, no independent validation exists. Theories about the creature's origins, whether from outer space or a parallel dimension, swirl without scientific backing.
